audit.why: Even lane (51.83% WR, 629 games). Early is Swain-favored at 1 (Nevermove root + soul sustain), Qiyana owns 2-5, Swain wins 6 duels, Qiyana spikes at first item, Swain outscales at two items. Content layer says this correctly; full-layer chart was flat Skill.
audit.corrected: Full-layer phases aligned to the content chart.

audit.why: Qiyana spikes: level 3 (E-Q-W all-in), first item; Swain spikes: level 6 (Demonic Ascension drain), two items (drain-tank). spikes[] already reflects this well.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; level chart in full layer was flat 'Skill' contradicting content win[]; two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Nevermove (E) 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s is the decisive cooldown — when it misses or is down, Qiyana's E-Q window opens. Demonic Ascension 120s flips duels. Swain P heals and stacks max HP (anti-heal matters; raw resists are not the answer).
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; chart made consistent; bleed bullets replaced.

edits.before: Grass Q from the river brush line — the stealth-empowered poke chunks and the lane learns to fear hedges.
edits.after: His Nevermove root into Q bolts plus soul heals out-trades your incomplete kit — respect level 1 and farm.

edits.before: W element economy begins: ice for the trades, rock for the executes, grass for the angles.
edits.after: W online: element trades now punish his 12s Nevermove cooldown, and the lane flips your way.

edits.before: E joins: the stick-dash into ice-Q root is your first real kill pattern — pick one window per wave.
edits.after: E joins: full E-Q-W bursts him before sustain items — all-in the moment his Nevermove misses.

edits.before: Element-cycle the trades: E-ice-Q roots, auto, rock-Q the execute line. The lane is a terrain quiz.
edits.after: Through 4-5 short trades still out-damage his soul healing — just dodge the telegraphed Nevermove.

edits.before: Supreme Display online — any fight near a wall is a stun lottery you rigged. Hug terrain like rent depends on it.
edits.after: His Demonic Ascension heals through your all-in and Demonflare nukes you — he wins the level 6 duel, so keep trades short.

edits.before: First item spike: the full element string deletes squishies. Force the brush-line fights.
edits.after: First item burst out-races his healing again — pick fights while his Nevermove is on cooldown.

edits.before: Late Qiyana flanks through her own R: shockwave the objective wall, string the stunned, and vanish into grass.
edits.after: Two-item Swain drain-tanks through your burst — stop dueling him; flank fights and reset onto his carries instead.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Terrashape (element swap) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Swain Nevermove (E): 12s at rank 1 — his only hard CC; when it misses or is down you have a full window to E-Q him. - Demonic Ascension: 120s — disengage the moment it starts, commit when it is spent. - Your R is also 120s: kill windows only.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: When he steps up to Q the wave, ice-Q the slow, E on, auto, W out — the string ends before his 12s Nevermove is back.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Terrashape is 7s but the element choice is the trade — swapping mid-fight leaves you rootless when his E returns.

edits.before: Swain wins by landing Demonic Ascension, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Swain wins by rooting your E engage with Nevermove, stacking Q bolts point-blank, and healing every trade back with souls.
